name: CRSMapUnit
summary: The CRSMapUnit class represents a length unit and the conversion factor from that unit to meters.

throws.when: If name is empty or conversion is <= 0.

methods.name: conversion
methods.summary: The #conversion method is used to retrieve the conversion factor between this map unit and meters.
methods.remarks: The #conversion method is used to retrieve the conversion factor between this map unit and meters.

methods.name: inspect
methods.summary: The #inspect method returns a string representation of the CRSMapUnit.
methods.remarks: The #inspect method returns a string representation of the CRSMapUnit.

methods.name: name
methods.summary: Note: For best interoperability with other BIM and GIS software this should follow the IFC The #name method is used to retrieve the name of the CRSMapUnit.
methods.remarks: Note: For best interoperability with other BIM and GIS software this should follow the IFC The #name method is used to retrieve the name of the CRSMapUnit. standard.

methods.name: to_s
methods.summary: The #to_s method returns a string containing a human-readable representation of the CRSMapUnit.
methods.remarks: The #to_s method returns a string containing a human-readable representation of the CRSMapUnit.

properties.summary: The #== method returns whether two Sketchup::CRSMapUnit are equal within tolerance.
properties.remarks: The #== method returns whether two Sketchup::CRSMapUnit are equal within tolerance.
